get.description: The attempt as the answer and result screens show it (after a reload too). Never grades.

post.description:
"Chấm lại": grade a submitted answer that has no grade yet; a graded one is returned as it
is, never paid for twice.

Save the last text and submit (nothing typed after the last draft save is lost), commit,
then grade. Submitting again, or from a second tab, grades what was submitted first.
End every session of the user, this one included (ADR-0020 §3).
Email a one-hour reset link if the account exists; the same answer either way (AC5).

get.description:
One document with its processing status (T4.9). Errors: 404 `document_not_found`
(another user's too).

post.description:
The file is stored: check it, mark the document uploaded and announce it to ai-service
(`document.uploaded.v1`, in the same transaction). Confirming again changes nothing.

Errors: 404 `document_not_found` (another user's too) or `subject_not_found` (deleted since);
409 `upload_incomplete` (nothing stored yet: upload, or ask for a new URL, then confirm);
422 `size_mismatch` or `content_mismatch`: the file is deleted and the document stays
refused, so the same file cannot be uploaded again; 503 `storage_unavailable`.

Locks the subject FOR SHARE, then the document FOR UPDATE: the order `reserve` takes them.
Limited per account (429): each confirm calls the store.

422.description: The file stored is not the PDF declared

get.description:
The table of contents of an indexed document (US-02 AC2), read from its derived file.

Errors: 404 `document_not_found` (another user's too); 409 `not_indexed`; 502 `toc_invalid`
(the file is not JSON or too large); 503 `storage_unavailable`.

post.description:
The draft of the current question, made on first call. The server picks the question:
a client cannot open an attempt on a question outside the session.

schema.title: Response Current Question V1 Review Sessions  Session Id  Current Get

post.description:
Close the session: "completed" when every question it can still ask is answered, else
"user_stopped". The session is locked first, so a submit in flight is counted (plan D14).
Stopping again changes nothing and answers the same.

schema.title: Response List Subjects V1 Subjects Get

delete.description:
Soft-delete a subject with no review history (us-01 AC8, T2.3b). Its exam, questions and
units stay but are hidden; the name can be used again. A subject with an attempt, a draft
included, answers 409 (deleting those comes with T6.3).

get.description:
The subject's documents, oldest first (T4.9). Errors: 404 `subject_not_found` (another
user's too).

schema.title: Response List Documents V1 Subjects  Subject Id  Documents Get

post.description:
A URL to upload one PDF to the subject (201), or the document it already is (200).

The same file (SHA-256) again: uploaded → `duplicate: true` and no URL; still uploading →
a fresh URL for the same document. Errors: 404 `subject_not_found`; 422
`unsupported_file_type`, `invalid_filename`, `file_too_large`, `size_mismatch` (the same
file asked with another size), `content_mismatch` (the same file was refused before); 409
`storage_quota_exceeded`; 429 with Retry-After; 503 `storage_full` or when a dependency is
down.

200.description: The file is already in the subject

delete.description:
Undo a skip; 204 whether or not the unit was skipped. Nothing is added to or taken from an
open session here: a question hidden by the skip is asked again, and the session cap (20)
hides the last replacement, if any (`progress`).
